units.source_text: 昔年削职去官的那个右近将监，早已恢复藏人之位，并兼卫门尉之职，今年又晋了爵。

en.t: The Ukon no Jo who had once been stripped of office had long since been restored to his post as chamberlain, also held the office of Emon no Jo, and this year had received another promotion in rank.

units.source_text: 他那模样与昔年流寓明石浦时大不相同，威武堂皇，神气十足。

en.t: He looked very different from the days when he had lived in exile at Akashi Bay, now imposing, splendid, and full of confidence.

units.source_text: 此刻他来拿源氏内大臣的佩刀，走过来侍立在他身旁。

en.t: Now he came to take the sword of Genji, the Inner Minister, and walked over to stand in attendance at his side.

units.source_text: 右近将监看见这里有一个熟识的侍女，便话里有话地说：

en.t: Seeing a maidservant there whom he knew, Ukon no Jo spoke with a hidden meaning in his words:

units.source_text: “我决不忘记昔年浦上的厚意。

en.t: I will never forget the kindness I received long ago on the shore.
But this time I have been most discourteous:

units.source_text: 我早上醒来，觉得此地很像明石浦，却无法给你写信请安。”

en.t: When I woke this morning, this place seemed very much like Akashi Bay, yet I could not write to you to ask after your health.

units.source_text: “这山乡僻壤，荒凉不减于朝雾弥漫的明石浦。

en.t: This remote mountain village is no less desolate than Akashi Bay when it is veiled in morning mist.

units.source_text: 况且亲友凋零，连苍松也已非故人了。

en.t: Besides, friends and kin have fallen away, and even the green pines are no longer old companions.

units.source_text: 承蒙你这不忘旧情的人前来问候，不胜欣慰。”

en.t: That someone like you, who has not forgotten old ties, has come to ask after me is an immeasurable comfort.

units.source_text: 右近将监觉得这个侍女误会太甚。

en.t: Ukon no Jo felt that this maidservant had misunderstood him badly.

units.source_text: 原来他以前曾经有意于明石姬，所以说这番话来暗示心事。

en.t: In fact, he had once been interested in the Lady of Akashi, and had spoken this way to hint at what was in his heart.

units.source_text: 这侍女却误认为他看中了她自己。

en.t: But the maidservant mistakenly thought that he had taken an interest in her instead.

units.source_text: 右近将监觉得出乎意外，便淡然地告别道：

en.t: Ukon no Jo found this unexpected, and took his leave rather coolly, saying:
I shall come to call again another day.
Then he followed the young lord out.
